title: Sort artifacts by creation time when determining latest artifacts for release
summary: AL-Go now sorts artifacts by creation time when determining the latest artifacts for release in multi-project repositories, fixing cases where Create Release with app version latest could select artifacts from different CI/CD runs.
key_points: After collecting non-expired artifacts, the script sorts them by created_at descending instead of trusting the endpoint order, which is by artifact id
latest now resolves each project to its most recently created artifact, and explicit-version lookups also prefer the newest match
The commit-mismatch error now names the artifact, the project and both commits
Regression tests replay out-of-order artifact ids and check the new error message
